title: Practice: Photosynthesis and Respiration Reactions
description: Low-stakes practice on reactants, products, energy storage and release, and gas cycling in photosynthesis and cellular respiration.

questions.question: Which word equation best represents photosynthesis?
options: glucose + oxygen -> carbon dioxide + water + energy
carbon dioxide + water + light energy -> glucose + oxygen
glucose + carbon dioxide -> oxygen + water + energy
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide, water, and light energy to produce glucose and oxygen.

questions.question: In cellular respiration, which pair of substances are the main reactants?
questions.explanation: Cellular respiration begins with glucose and oxygen, then produces carbon dioxide, water, and energy.

questions.question: True or False: Photosynthesis stores energy in glucose.
questions.explanation: True. Light energy is converted into chemical energy stored in the bonds of glucose.

questions.question: True or False: Plants perform photosynthesis but never perform cellular respiration.
questions.explanation: False. Plant cells also perform cellular respiration to release usable energy from glucose.

questions.question: Complete the product of photosynthesis: carbon dioxide + water + light energy -> glucose + _____.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis produces glucose and oxygen. Oxygen may be written as the word oxygen or as O2.

questions.question: Complete the missing reactant in respiration: glucose + _____ -> carbon dioxide + water + energy.
questions.explanation: Oxygen is required in aerobic cellular respiration to help release energy from glucose.

questions.question: Which statement best explains how photosynthesis and respiration are connected?
options: Both reactions use oxygen as a reactant.
Both reactions release energy from glucose.
The products of one reaction can become reactants of the other.
Only animals use the products of photosynthesis.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis produces glucose and oxygen, which respiration uses. Respiration produces carbon dioxide and water, which photosynthesis uses.

questions.question: In one or two sentences, explain why cellular respiration is important to plant cells.
questions.correctAnswer: Plant cells need cellular respiration to release usable energy from glucose for growth, repair, transport, and other cell activities.
questions.explanation: Plants can make glucose, but cells still need to break glucose down through respiration to access usable energy.
